description: nhflow_3d_si_mb_basin_wavy at rest with a met file (W 200 2, met-forcing.r3m: wind and air pressure, 7 records over 6 h) on the curvilinear multi-block grid: sampling at the cell centres XC2D/YC2D and the pressure gradient through geo_grad. The static inverse barometer is reproduced within 0.18 mm of 5.6 mm.
